title: Unravel: Recovering an Interactive 3D Scene from a Single Image
abstract: arXiv:2610.16146v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We present Unravel, a training-free framework that turns a single image into an interactive 3D scene, where every object is an independent and movable asset. Existing generators either produce one entangled geometry in which no object can be moved, or predict all objects in one feed-forward pass, where a wrong guess cannot be detected or repaired. Unravel instead takes a different approach: it first takes the scene apart, and then puts it back together. Starting from the input image, an agentic harness that iteratively peels the image layer by layer, and adopts point cloud as major modality for spatial relationship recovery. Specifically, a vision-language model plans which objects are fully visible, an image editor removes them and restores the occluded regions. translated_title: Unravel：从单张图像中恢复交互式3D场景
translated_abstract: 我们提出了Unravel，这是一个无需训练的框架，能够将单张图像转化为交互式3D场景，其中每个物体都是独立且可移动的资产。现有的生成器要么产生一个相互纠缠的几何体，导致无法移动任何物体；要么在前馈过程中一次性预测所有物体，导致错误的猜测无法被检测或修复。Unravel采取了不同的方法：它先将场景拆解，然后再将其重新组合。从输入图像开始，一个智能体框架逐层迭代地剥离图像，并采用点云作为恢复空间关系的主要模态。具体而言，视觉-语言模型规划哪些物体是完全可见的，图像编辑器将它们移除并恢复被遮挡的区域。每次编辑在纳入重建之前都会经过验证。这一过程逐渐将场景中被遮挡的部分转化为直接观察，使物体能够……
tldr: Unravel是一个无需训练的框架，通过智能体逐层剥离图像、利用视觉-语言模型规划可见物体、图像编辑器恢复遮挡区域并逐次验证编辑，将单张图像分解重建为由独立可移动物体组成的交互式3D场景。
en_tdlr: Unravel is a training-free framework that turns a single image into an interactive 3D scene with independently movable objects by iteratively peeling the image layer by layer, using a vision-language model to plan visible objects and an image editor to restore occluded regions, with every edit verified before reconstruction.
